visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a lush, green tropical forest with dense palm-like leaves. A young man with short dark hair and silver earrings is seen from a side-low angle, holding a handheld camera gimbal and pointing it towards a plant. An older man in a black t-shirt is partially visible in the background, leaning down into the foliage. The lighting is natural and diffused by the canopy. (2) The focus shifts to the older man, who is wearing a black t-shirt and patterned shorts. He holds a long, thin plant stalk and uses a small knife to peel the outer layer. His facial expression is calm and focused as he demonstrates the technique. The background is a wall of green leaves and stalks. A nameplate identifying him as 'Teacher Xie' appears briefly. (3) The young man holds the peeled, translucent stalk, looking at it curiously. The camera moves closer to capture the texture of the plant. A woman wearing a black bucket hat and glasses enters the frame, standing next to the young man. They all hold small sections of the peeled plant as if preparing for a toast. (4) The young man puts the plant stalk into his mouth and bites down. Immediately, his face scrunches up in an extreme reaction; his eyes squint tightly, his mouth twists, and he laughs out of surprise. The woman in the background laughs and points. Yellow and white variety-style captions pop up around his head to emphasize the 'sour' reaction. The camera maintains a medium close-up on his expressive face.
